<STBG 5,0><BGM 0,0,504><MWT 5><COL FEEB4EFF>Walking on <COL FEEB4EFF>Adopo Hill</COL>, I found
a monument and an offering.

<MWT 4>The monument had weathered away
past recognition, but the offering
beside it was intact.

<MWT 4>The offering was a mirror, and its
polish shows it was treasured...
